observations: Three retail boxes for Sony PlayStation 5 consoles are shown.
The boxes feature the 'Sony' and 'PS5' logos.
The console design depicted on the boxes is the 'Slim' revision with a disc drive bulge.
A large watermark 'SOPHY GADGETS' is superimposed on the image.
The background appears to be a retail shop with gaming accessories on shelves.
No factory seals are clearly visible on the box edges in this view.

claims.evidence: The box art in photo 0 shows the PS5 logo and the specific design of the Slim model with the horizontal slit.
While retail boxes are shown, no factory seals are visible, and the contents are not shown.

risks.risk: The console may be used or refurbished despite the packaging.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the intact factory security seals on the box openings.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have a hardware defect.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the setup or home screen.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual console and controller outside of the box.

proof_requests: Photo of the factory seals on the top and bottom of the box.
Photo of the console and controller outside the box with a handwritten note of today's date.
Video of the console powered on and connected to a screen.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a PlayStation 5 Slim from the retail packaging, allowing it to be priced at its worst case (used/not working).
